character_name: Johann Ludwig of the Dornburg branch
image_prompt: Johann Ludwig of Dornburg as a cyberpunk anime character: a lean, austere man in his mid-forties with sharp, angular facial features and a stern expression conveying quiet resignation. He has pale, translucent skin and piercing steel-gray eyes with cybernetic enhancements—subtle neon blue circuitry visible at the temples. His hair is dark, pulled back severely in an 18th-century style but with holographic threads woven through. He wears a high-collared formal coat in deep charcoal with geometric neon patterns outlining the seams, paired with archaic Prussian military decorations integrated with glowing tech components. His neck displays a thin luminescent collar characteristic of cyberpunk design. His posture is rigidly upright, embodying pious restraint and hierarchical formality. His hands are pale and long-fingered, with subtle bioluminescent veins visible beneath the skin. His overall appearance merges rigid 18th-century aristocratic formality with cyberpunk aesthetics—a figure trapped between duty and technological advancement, conveying melancholic acceptance of his constrained fate through both traditional dress and futuristic technological elements.
